items.title: First Final Fantasy Tubbz Rubber Ducks Come From FFXIV
items.summary: The first Final Fantasy Tubbz rubber ducks are of FFXIV heroes G'raha Tia, Krile, and Tataru and debut later in 2026.
items.content:
There are now Final Fantasy designs in the Tubbz rubber duck line based on characters from FFXIV . Three options inspired by G’raha Tia, Krile Maya Baldesion, and Tataru will appear. These will be available in $19.99 standard and $24.99 collector ’ s edition with bathtub display box variants. All of them are expected to start showing up on December 14, 2026.

The G’raha Tia, Krile Maya Baldesion, and Tataru rubber ducks are all standard size, so they’re about three and a half inches tall. Each is dressed in their most recent in-game costumes. So the Miqo’te carries a staff and is in his most recent outfit, Krile is a Pictomancer with brush, and Tataru is wearing her standard pink outfit with signature hat.

Here are the direct links to each of the FFXIV G’raha Tia, Krile, and Tataru Tubbz rubber ducks from Amazon. The standard G’raha Tia pre-orders already sold out there.

And here are all the official photos of the ducks and their boxes.

The Final Fantasy Tubbz rubber ducks based on G’raha Tia, Krile Maya Baldesion, and Tataru from FFXIV will debut on December 14, 2026. The MMORPG is on the Switch 2, PS4, PS5, Xbox Series X, and PC, and the Evercold expansion will release on February 23, 2027.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14 patches "certain words" out of Keyboard Brawler, making the MMO's limited-time minigame a little less impossible
items.summary: Square Enix gives our fingers a break
items.content:
JRPGs Final Fantasy Final Fantasy XIV Final Fantasy 14 patches "certain words" out of Keyboard Brawler, making the MMO's limited-time minigame a little less impossible News By Anna Koselke Published 10 November 2026 Square Enix gives our fingers a break

(Image credit: Square Enix) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Final Fantasy 14 fans have spent weeks grappling with its new typing minigame, Keyboard Brawler, and the bots and impossible words it's been throwing at them – but Patch 7.58 has arrived, and it makes the Gold Saucer event a tad easier, thankfully.

Keyboard Brawler is great, if you ask me, even if it can be challenging. Its limited-time nature means you'll want to grind it out as soon as you're able, however, before it departs in January and the new expansion Evercold takes hold of your attention. The thing is, though, it's not so simple to tackle should a foreign word come up that doesn't match your keyboard's region – like, say, doppelgänger… and, until now, such words have indeed come up.

I've run into the dreaded umlaut-ridden words myself, panicking on the spot only to find out I could've used a keyboard shortcut or something similar to type them out. Better yet, Square Enix is on the case now itself with some tweaks as part of its official Patch 7.58 notes – yes, the very same Patch 7.58 that sees Europe and North America's servers merge in Party Finder (raiders, this one's truly for us) – addressing this and Keyboard Brawler's other problems.

For instance, "An issue when participating in Keybound Brawler wherein players were erroneously determined to be inactive and subsequently removed from the duty." And then, "An issue when participating in Keybound Brawler wherein, after disconnecting and reconnecting under certain conditions, words no longer appeared during the duty, and words would no longer refresh when re-entering the duty."

Square Enix also covers "an issue wherein setting the display of enhancements and enfeeblements to 'Display as Single Element' would result in status icons displaying in the wrong position after leaving Keybound Brawler – and, finally, "an issue when participating in Keybound Brawler wherein certain words not intended for the duty would appear." That's the one… the one I know I've been eagerly awaiting.

Final Fantasy 14's new typing minigame already causing chaos with bots and impossible words Final Fantasy 14 devs beg players to "take time to read" the MMO's options before Evercold is out Final Fantasy 14 Evercold won't suffer from Dawntrail's pacing issues, Yoshi-P says, MMO commits to respecting your time Patch 7.58 boasts quite a few more welcome adjustments to the MMO overall, of course, aside from Keyboard Brawler-specific changes, so I'd recommend giving it a full read. I know I'm excited to farm UMAD properly finally, personally.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Patch 7.58 Notes and Changes
items.summary: Final Fantasy XIV Patch 7.58 brings regional matchmaking changes, a stronger Savage raid Echo, Crystalline Conflict Season 22, and gameplay fixes.
items.content:
Square Enix has released Final Fantasy XIV Patch 7.58, introducing adjustments to the Crucible of the Unbroken, increased Echo bonuses in AAC Heavyweight Tier (Savage), and the beginning of Crystalline Conflict Season 22. The update also removes several weekly reward restrictions, increases the drop rate of Wings of Nihility, and makes changes to Trust NPC experience gains and Free Company housing.

Same-region matchmaking is also being expanded to North American and European data centres, with the feature scheduled to become available soon. The patch additionally addresses several issues affecting the Crucible of the Unbroken, Keybound Brawler, Duty Roulette, and other gameplay systems.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Preorders Are Now Live, Includes Standard & Collector's Editions
items.summary: Square Enix has launched preorders for Final Fantasy XIV Evercold, which arrives in February 2027. Get more details here.
items.content:
Pre-orders for the Standard and Collector’s Editions of the Final Fantasy XIV expansion, Evercold, have gone live ahead of its highly anticipated launch on February 23, 2027. You can purchase it as a collector’s bundle, which includes a digital version of the game but only on PC, which is a little odd considering the whole point of no disc was to include digital codes for the other systems. The Collector’s Box, which is just the physical merchandise, has also launched. At the time of writing, the EU/UK versions are now live, with the NA store getting the box added later on in the day at 10AM PST.

The bundles in the UK are £239.99 for the Collector’s Box and £289.99 for the Collector’s Bundle, which for some reason is a different button for PC/MAC, so make sure you pick the correct one. Also, this is not a Steam code. If you are on a PC and wish to purchase the Steam version, make sure to buy the box and then buy the Collector’s Edition separately.

In addition, the console versions are sold separately too, so you will need to visit the PSN Store if you wish to purchase the standard or collectors edition of Evercold. However, note that the licence for the game is not shared, and you will need to purchase the expansion on any platforms you play on, the items are so you only need to purchase the Collectors Edition once if you do own the game on several platforms.

The digital collectors edition that you get when either buying the bundle or on its own, will include the following:

If you preorder any edition before February 23, you will gain access to the following:

If you get the pre-order in, then you will gain access to Evercold around 9AM GMT (subject to change also please convert to your local timezone) on February 19, rather than February 23. The earring also continues the trend of EXP increasing items; this item will give you +30% EXP from enemies you defeat as you level up to 100. Plus, the Wind-up Köttr Minion I feel like is going to be a fan favourite with a heap of players simply due to how adorable it is. For more details on Everrcold, be sure to check out our recent Fanfest coverage here.

Bungie has revealed that Marathon’s Symbiosis update is launching on December 8, adding new PvE and PvP modes, weapons, and more.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed, New Release Date Announced at FFXIV Fan Fest
items.summary: The MMORPG's next expansion was set to launch shortly after the new year, but Warriors of Light will have to wait a bit longer.
items.content:
Final Fantasy XIV Evercold was set to launch sometime in January 2027, which was announced as part of its initial reveal back in April this year during the North American FFXIV Fan Fest. However, this next expansion for the critically acclaimed MMORPG has been delayed – FFXIV Evercold's release date is now February 23, 2027 (and February 19, 2027 for early access). This was announced alongside the new, full trailer / intro cinematic for Evercold at FFXIV Fan Fest in Japan, and was said to only be a four-week delay.

In typical FFXIV fashion, the third and final teaser trailer is the full opening cinematic for an expansion, and it kicked off the Japan Fan Fest keynote where director and producer Naoki Yoshida presented more details on new features, where the ongoing story is headed, and fundemental gameplay changes as FFXIV goes into version 8.0 alongside Evercold's launch.

Pre-orders for Evercold open on November 4, 2026 and will come with a Wind-up Kottr minion to summon and follow you around in the world and Halone's Earring which will boost the EXP you gain for Jobs under level 100 when equipped. The collector's edition comes with the Valhallar Odin mount, the Entreat Crystal emote, and the Crystal Skyltborg which looks like glam for the new Bastion Job's weapons. The physical collector's bundle has the Evercold art book, the Tapestry of the Fourth decoration, a Kottr plush, a keychain of the Ethos Metal, and the Warrior of Light Reaper figure.

Additionally, we got a glimpse of the second new Job coming to his new expansion. It's a ranged DPS called Zephyr, which rocks a crossbow as their primary weapon and commands an avian companion to provide support.

There's a lot coming to FFXIV Evercold in addition to a new world and main story including a Neon Genesis Evangelion crossover raid series (which got a new teaser trailer) , a Final Fantasy VII crossover raid series, a new Tank Job with Bastion, and much more. Be sure to check out my Dawntrail review as well to look back at the last expansion before heading into this new era for FFXIV.

items.title: “ZEPHYR” UNVEILED AS SECOND NEW JOB FOR FINAL FANTASY XIV: EVERCOLD, SET TO RELEASE ON TUESDAY, FEB. 23, 2027
items.summary: Critically Acclaimed MMO Surpasses 35 Million Registered Accounts; Pre-order Information, New EVANGELION Series Crossover Trailer and More Revealed
items.content: LOS ANGELES (Oct. 31, 2026) – During the FINAL FANTASY XIV Fan Festival 2026 in Tokyo, SQUARE ENIX® announced that its critically acclaimed MMORPG FINAL FANTASY XIV Online has reached more than 35 million registered accounts globally and revealed new information about Evercold , the newest expansion set to release on Tuesday, Feb. 23, 2027. During the opening keynote, Producer and Director Naoki Yoshida revealed “zephyr,” the second of two new jobs arriving in Evercold . A physical ranged DPS, zephyr joins the fray using a combination of crossbow shots and support from an avian familiar known as Nephele. A trailer showcasing the zephyr in action can be seen here: https://youtu.be/qX5jtcXjmts The keynote also introduced the full-length trailer for Evercold , which can be seen here: https://youtu.be/8mN8N5O5ru0

items.title: Keybound Brawler Arrives October 28!
items.summary: Keybound Brawler, a new event that tests your typing prowess, is coming to the Manderville Gold Saucer! The first iteration of the event will be a special collaboration with the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE series. Participate in the collaborat
items.content:
Keybound Brawler, a new event that tests your typing prowess, is coming to the Manderville Gold Saucer! The first iteration of the event will be a special collaboration with the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE series. Participate in the collaboration stages to obtain MGC which can be exchanged for numerous rewards, including collaboration attire, a mount, emote, and more!

Event Duration

From Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 19:00 (AEDT) to the release of Patch 8.0 * The end date listed on Steam does not reflect the release date for Patch 8.0.

How to Participate

Begin the quest "Keyward Bound" by speaking to the Catlike Mammet in The Gold Saucer (X:5.4 Y:7.0). * Players must be level 15 and above to start the quest. * Players must first complete one of the following main scenario quests: "The Gridanian Envoy," "The Ul'dahn Envoy," or "The Lominsan Envoy." * Players must first complete the quest "It Could Happen to You" to be able to travel to the Manderville Gold Saucer via airship from any of the three city-states. * Please note that a keyboard is required to participate in this content. Gamepads and on-screen keyboards cannot be used.

Rewards

* After this collaboration event has ended, it will be held as a special event at irregular intervals. Visit the special site for more details.
